svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Deposit flow: fiat to USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of a deposit between the client wallet, Stablecue (Anchor Platform and engine), the CASP and the Stellar network, with the Stablecue intent state shown at each stage.
svg.text: Deposit flow: fiat to USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar
Client → Stablecue → CASP · SEP-10, SEP-12, SEP-24
signed in the client’s own wallet
JWT valid, CASP reports KYC accepted
Every state transition is appended to the immutable event log: intent_id → SEP-24 transaction id → CASP order id → Stellar tx hash. Wallet-visible status flows through the Platform API.
Solid arrows: requests and actions. Dashed arrows: responses and callbacks. Arrow colour = sender (teal client, indigo Stablecue, amber CASP, grey Stellar).
